-- Regression Summary — New Failures vs Recovered (latest run vs previous)
-- Source: {{history_table}}
-- Purpose: KPI counters + drives the change-detail table
-- ============================================================
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT test_suite, catalog, schema, table, run_timestamp,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY test_suite, catalog, schema, table
                            ORDER BY run_timestamp DESC) AS run_rank
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT test_suite, catalog, schema, table, run_timestamp
        FROM {{history_table}}
        WHERE catalog = '{{catalog}}' AND test_suite IS NOT NULL
          AND schema IN ({{schemas}}){{expected_filter}}
          AND instr(table, '.') = 0 AND (DATE_FORMAT(run_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :sel_date OR :sel_date = 'All' OR :sel_date IS NULL OR :sel_date = ''))
),
piv AS (
  SELECT h.schema, h.table, h.check_name, COALESCE(h.column,'') AS col,
         MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_rank=1 THEN h.passed END) AS now_pass,
         MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_rank=2 THEN h.passed END) AS prev_pass
  FROM {{history_table}} h
  JOIN runs r ON h.test_suite=r.test_suite AND h.catalog=r.catalog AND h.schema=r.schema
             AND h.table=r.table AND h.run_timestamp=r.run_timestamp
  WHERE r.run_rank IN (1,2)
  GROUP BY h.schema, h.table, h.check_name, COALESCE(h.column,'')
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN prev_pass=true  AND now_pass=false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS newly_broken,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prev_pass=false AND now_pass=true  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recovered,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prev_pass=false AND now_pass=false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS still_failing
FROM piv;

WITH runs AS (
  SELECT test_suite, catalog, schema, table, run_timestamp,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY test_suite, catalog, schema, table
                            ORDER BY run_timestamp DESC) AS run_rank
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT test_suite, catalog, schema, table, run_timestamp
        FROM {{history_table}}
        WHERE catalog = '{{catalog}}' AND test_suite IS NOT NULL
          AND schema IN ({{schemas}}){{expected_filter}}
          AND instr(table, '.') = 0 AND (DATE_FORMAT(run_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :sel_date OR :sel_date = 'All' OR :sel_date IS NULL OR :sel_date = ''))
),
piv AS (
  SELECT h.schema, h.table, h.check_name, COALESCE(h.column,'') AS col,
         MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_rank=1 THEN h.passed END) AS now_pass,
         MAX(CASE WHEN r.run_rank=2 THEN h.passed END) AS prev_pass
  FROM {{history_table}} h
  JOIN runs r ON h.test_suite=r.test_suite AND h.catalog=r.catalog AND h.schema=r.schema
             AND h.table=r.table AND h.run_timestamp=r.run_timestamp
  WHERE r.run_rank IN (1,2)
  GROUP BY h.schema, h.table, h.check_name, COALESCE(h.column,'')
)
SELECT CONCAT(schema, '.', table) AS `table`, check_name, col AS `column`,
  CASE WHEN prev_pass=true  AND now_pass=false THEN 'NEW FAILURES'
       WHEN prev_pass=false AND now_pass=true  THEN 'RECOVERED' END AS change_type
FROM piv
WHERE (prev_pass=true AND now_pass=false) OR (prev_pass=false AND now_pass=true)
ORDER BY change_type, `table`;
